outcome: Apoptosis of peripheral blood T-lymphocyte subsets
cohort: The study included 150 neonatal patients with sepsis randomized into a vitamin D treatment group and a control group, alongside 100 healthy newborns as a healthy control group.
finding: Vitamin D treatment significantly improved the prognosis of neonatal sepsis patients by increasing CD4+ T-lymphocytes, normalizing the CD4+/CD8+ ratio, and reducing inflammatory factor levels within 72 hours.
